content.text:
How Micron Stock Could Rise Another 50%: Reports that Arcuri reiterated a $1,625 target and Buy rating in a Wednesday note, forecast fiscal Q4 revenue of $52.4 billion and EPS of $32.50, and outlined a buyback scenario of about $20 billion per quarter rising toward $50 billion. It also reports his conditional scenario that memory prices could fall 80% after a cycle peak expected in H2 2028 while annualized earnings remain above current levels. These are attributed forecasts and assumptions. (time=2026-09-24T19:37:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

Acer CEO says memory makers are hyping 2030 shortage fears to protect margins: Reports Acer CEO Jason Chen's view that component prices could reverse in the second half of 2027, that some memory and SSD supply was ample, and that lower-cost Chinese suppliers could disrupt the market. The report attributes the comments to Chen and DigiTimes. (time=2026-09-21; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
